# Gems

_Generated from PoB tree data `3.29`. Regenerate after any data update._

Rules covering both categories. Active gems are in `skills.md`, supports in
`supports.md` - both list only obtainable gems.

Nothing in PoB's UI or file format stops you picking an unobtainable gem. Check here
while choosing; `validate.lua` catches it after the fact, when it costs a rebuild.

## Not obtainable

Unobtainable in a fresh league - do not put these in a build. Grouped by category;
a category is omitted when nothing in it is unobtainable.

## Upgraded support tiers

`grantedEffect.plusVersionOf` links a support to its upgraded version. 20 supports
have an obtainable upgrade; a support absent from this table has none, so do not go
looking for one. Most upgrades are a renamed gem rather than an `Awakened *` one -
that line is gone bar Empower, Enhance and Enlighten. An upgrade beats its base at
every level, so prefer it whenever it exists.

| base support | upgraded version |
|---|---|
| Ancestral Call | Greater Ancestral Call |
| Archmage | Frostmage |
| Blasphemy | Eldritch Blasphemy |
| Chain | Greater Chain |
| Culling Strike | Cull the Weak |
| Cursed Ground | Hextoad |
| Devour | Greater Devour |
| Empower | Awakened Empower |
| Enhance | Awakened Enhance |
| Enlighten | Awakened Enlighten |
| Fork | Greater Fork |
| Kinetic Instability | Greater Kinetic Instability |

| Spell Cascade | Greater Spell Cascade |

| Trinity | Unholy Trinity |
| Unleash | Greater Unleash |
| Volley | Greater Volley |

## Level caps

Every gem can be corrupted to one level above its natural max, with no exceptions.
Cap is always `naturalMaxLevel + 1`; per-gem natural maxes are in `skills.md` and
`supports.md`.
